thread:
maria: Quick kickoff — I'm assembling the enterprise legal-hold + retention-exception runbook for BYOK/private customers. Goal: ship minimal safe flow in next sprint. Need acceptance criteria, owners, and any hard blockers.
ben: Quick clarifying q — scope includes audit logs exports, legal-hold API, retention overrides, and BYOK handshake? Who owns export packaging (signed manifest)?
dina: 👍 ops owns export orchestration + temp storage staging. We'll need an immutable snapshot step + checksum + retention TTL metadata. Oncall: eng-oncall for infra, compliance-ops for legal coordination.
chet: Security note — BYOK requires KMS attestation and proof-of-possession. Propose handshake: customer uploads public cert -> we issue a short-lived challenge -> customer signs -> we verify -> store key-id reference (not raw key). Also add key-rotation audit entries.
maria: Exactly. Also need rollback rules for accidental holds. Proposed acceptance criteria (first pass):
1) Legal hold API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/holds {reason, scope, expires_at?} and DELETE to clear.
2) Export bundle: includes signed manifest.json with sha256 checksums and acting principal identity.
3) Audit log entries for every action include principal, ip, key_id (if BYOK), and request_id.
4) Emergency escape: ability to apply temporary hold removal in <15m with two-person approval.
ashley: Product asks — how will customers request exceptions? UI + API? We should include a runbook template for customer-facing handoff and TOS/contract flags for retention overrides.
ben: From infra perspective: we need storage tier map for export bundles (hot vs cold) and TTL semantics. Also define cost owner for long-retention exports.
dina: Runbook snippet for ops playbook (draft):
```
# Emergency legal hold snapshot
1) curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants/123/holds" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"reason":"legal request","scope":"all","expires_at":null}'
2) run: /opt/redwood/bin/snapshot --tenant 123 --output /tmp/hold-123.tar.gz
3) checksum: sha256sum /tmp/hold-123.tar.gz > /tmp/hold-123.sha256
4) upload to secure-bucket://holds/123/$(date +%s)/ and tag with manifest + immutable flag
```
chet: Add: before step 2, run KMS challenge verify if tenant has BYOK; fail closed if verification fails. Also attach HSM attestation ID to manifest.
maria: Asking reviewers: @ashley please confirm product acceptance items; @chet please confirm security gating; @dina to confirm ops steps + oncall owners. Need signoff by Friday EOD to target sprint start.
ben: ACK. I'll add storage TTL mapping doc and cost allocation notes into the runbook.
ashley: Product OK with the acceptance list but request: add UX copy for legal teams + an audit export sanity check (verify manifest signatures).
ops-bot: runbook: /docs/runbooks/enterprise-legalhold-v1.md updated by maria at 2024-03-12T09:22:14Z :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks team — I'll push a PR with the full runbook and a short playbook for oncall. If anyone has strong objections to the emergency escape (two-person approval), flag now. Otherwise I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
